title: YatraCanvas DataFactory — Generic Resolver & Name-Normalization Hardening Report

old_resolution.root_cause: GeoNames cities15000 omitted sub-15k hill station (pop ~8,099). Resolver scored state matching additively (+50) rather than enforcing it as a mandatory hard filter, causing North Chennai industrial suburb to win.
old_resolution.dataset_impact: 3,758 released places located 2,000 km south in Tamil Nadu. Zero Himalayan places.

new_resolution.fallback_source_used: OSM / Nominatim Administrative & Locality Resolution with strict address state validation
new_resolution.preflight_consistency_check: PASSED (single candidate and coordinates agreed with requested Himalayan destination)

examples: Museum of Himachal Culture & Folk Arts

manali.verdict_reason: Correctly resolved to Himachal Pradesh. Himalayan POIs naturally discovered, 100% search precision, 0 Tamil Nadu leakage. Ready for staging integration with minor warnings.

apollo_pharmacy_before.name: Apollo Pharmacy Railway Station Road Rishikesh
apollo_pharmacy_before.cause: Address token 'Railway Station Road' matched regex with weight 4.0 without checking shop keywords or structured transit evidence.

apollo_pharmacy_after.name: Apollo Pharmacy Railway Station Road Rishikesh
apollo_pharmacy_after.cause: Disqualified from transit heuristic due to shop keyword 'pharmacy' and address pattern 'Road'. Accurately classified as retail shop.

rishikesh.verdict_reason: Clean generalization: 0 conflicts, 62 Wikivoyage listings discovered, 100% Wikidata recall, transit false positive eliminated, 98% search precision.

commercial_junctions_before.cause: Loose keyword 'junction' matched transit heuristic without structured transit evidence.

commercial_junctions_after.cause: Removed loose 'junction' keyword from transit heuristics; required structured railway/bus tags.

panaji.verdict_reason: Clean generalization: 0 conflicts, transit false positives resolved, high image coverage (83.3%), 96.2% search precision.

name_conflicts_investigated.case: Rishikesh: Ganga Jamuna Restaurant vs Mamta Restaurant
name_conflicts_investigated.nature: Neighboring distinct businesses located 23 meters apart on Laxman Jhula Road (one opposite the other).
name_conflicts_investigated.previous_issue: Falsely merged into a single entity due to generic token 'Restaurant' triggering similarity 0.72 within 25m. Allowed single-source unverified records to escape quarantine via an artificial multi-source confidence boost.
name_conflicts_investigated.generic_fix: Distinctive token extraction strips generic category words (Restaurant, Hotel, Cafe, etc.). Because distinctive overlap was empty and distinctive similarity was 0.0, the merge was strictly rejected.
name_conflicts_investigated.post_fix_status: Kept separate as distinct entities. Both evaluated individually and quarantined under quality scoring (score 0.285 < 0.30).

name_conflicts_investigated.case: Panaji: Cafe Mambos vs Mambo Disco Club
name_conflicts_investigated.nature: Daytime cafe vs nighttime disco club branding sharing the same website (titos.in/cafe-mambo.html) and location (13m apart).
name_conflicts_investigated.previous_issue: Merged correctly by shared website, but independent verifier flagged it as a name conflict because it only checked canonical name string without checking alternate names or stem variations.
name_conflicts_investigated.generic_fix: Independent verifier checks alternate_names, alternate_name_records, and stem normalization (mambos vs mambo).
name_conflicts_investigated.post_fix_status: Verified as a valid recorded upstream alias. 0 conflicts flagged.

quarantined_invalid_builds.reason: Requested Manali, Himachal Pradesh but resolved to North Chennai, Tamil Nadu due to unconstrained state filter in cities15000.
